name: attraction-shortform-system
description: PLUGIN 4 — the Short-Form Attraction Engine (Week 4). The daily Instagram engine that gets the member in front of agents and builds trust. One-session setup: confirm your profiles and keyword → your Game Plan → your Notion board → your workflows → your first Reel. Two keywords, never more: GUIDE sends the guide, the offer's own word opens the invitation; every call to action follows Mike's law (the person's help, free, to run the method). The six posts designed in Week 3 go first — post, don't make — then the Reels. Eleven draft-only workflows, each on only when the member says yes; six recommended: Monday week plan, Sunday batch prep, daily engagement list, Wednesday news watch, Friday note, monthly refill; optional: keyword follow-up queue, mid-week nudge, monthly deep dive, daily stories, quarterly profile audit. Every write pushes to the Brain, so the Brain Board stays current. Bring your own Notion, Metricool, GoHighLevel or ManyChat; nothing posts on its own. Requires Plugin 1, the Brain.
